formattedAddress: No. 194號, Section 1, Xiyuan Rd, Qingshan Village, Wanhua District, Taipei City, Taiwan 108

text.text:
Liang Xi Hao literally means “a house of double happiness.”🇹

After the two women made their wishes at Longshan Temple,
this was the very first place we stepped into among the nearby eateries.

'Squid Thick Soup' wasn’t exactly to my taste, to be honest.

But 'Braised Milkfish Belly' gave me, a devoted lover of fish, a quiet kind of delight. 😍
Its flavor was delicate yet rich, with a subtle oiliness that made it unexpectedly appealing.

We dined on the second floor. The space was calm and tidy, pleasantly removed from the noise of the busy street below. That slight distance from the crowd made it even more enjoyable.

And the prices were kind. Truly excellent value for money.

So naturally, it earns a high rating from me. 😄

text.text: This restaurant is small and doesn’t provide dedicated car parking. The noodles are soft, with a clear yet rich and thick broth. The fried pork and cuttlefish are tasty, tender, and full of flavor. The fried noodles, in my opinion, are okay but nothing special. We also ordered fish crackers—it’s better to ask for them to be served without being soaked in the soup. Overall, the service is good and fast.

text.text: I like the thick soup with rice. The stir fried noodle is interesting. The veggie stir fry is good and nice. Waitress is very nice to us as she explained how each sauce supposed to be used. Food is hot and clean. Nice price.

text.text: Loved this place from our recent trip. I liked the rice and braised pork (which I believe is a more traditional Taiwanese meal). The servings were a good size and never left the place feeling hungry. Super priced as well with very rapid service
